# unifi_setting_mdns_scope (Resource)

Manages global mDNS network scope on UniFi OS Network 11.0.99. Writes only scope and explicitly selected networks, preserving service filters and other global settings. Unknown application versions refuse writes. Destroy relinquishes ownership without changing the controller. Import uses `site:mdns-scope`. Do not manage this singleton from multiple provider processes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "unifi_setting_mdns_scope" "selected_networks" {
  scope       = "some"
  network_ids = [unifi_network.lan.id, unifi_network.iot.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope` (String) Networks participating in mDNS: `all`, `none`, or `some`.

### Optional

- `network_ids` (Set of String) Declare a nonempty set for `some`. Omit for `all` or `none`; the controller-derived set is then read-only.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import unifi_setting_mdns_scope.selected_networks default:mdns-scope
```
